async function haveFiveRawIronIntoIronIngots(bot) {
    // This function checks if the player has at least five iron ingots. If not, it determines how many more are needed and verifies that enough raw iron is available. It then locates or places a furnace block nearby. Next, it searches for a suitable fuel source, such as coal or wood planks, ensuring enough is present. Finally, it smelts the required raw iron into iron ingots using the found fuel.
}
